update_metadata_cli: run the update_metadata CLI to push updated framework and pipeline_tags metadata to huggingface/transformers-metadata dataset
check_pipeline_tags_cli: run the update_metadata CLI in check-only mode to verify all pipeline tags are defined in PIPELINE_TAGS_AND_AUTO_MODELS
update_pipeline_and_auto_class_table: update the table mapping model classes to pipeline tags and auto model classes using PIPELINE_TAGS_AND_AUTO_MODELS constant
get_frameworks_table: get a pandas DataFrame of supported model types with their PyTorch support status and processor type mappings
check_pipeline_tags: check that all pipeline tags from SUPPORTED_TASKS are present in the PIPELINE_TAGS_AND_AUTO_MODELS constant
